CRITICAL.definition: Active threat or guaranteed failure. Production data loss, security breach, broken main branch, data corruption.

IMPORTANT.definition: Latent bug or risk that will cause failure under reasonable conditions. Not yet broken but will break.

COSMETIC.definition: Style, duplication, or hygiene issue with no functional impact. Worth fixing but never urgent.
examples: duplicate config keys with same value
single point of failure documented elsewhere

categories.logic: Decisions that seemed correct but have a reasoning flaw
categories.assumption: Things taken for granted without verification
categories.overconfidence: Places where execution happened without enough questioning
categories.risk: Unconsidered consequences or side effects of changes made
categories.redo: Work that may need to be redone before it surfaces later

events.clean: Session finished normally with zero findings
events.audit-failed: Audit subagent failed or returned unparseable output
events.aborted: Session aborted (lane timeout, T1 detected failure)

triggers.split-t1: Invoked by splittasks T1 orchestrator at close-out
triggers.session-end-hook: Invoked by SessionEnd hook on solo sessions
